top_signals.title: Gaw Capital-Led Group Seeks to Refinance $1.8 Billion Loan
top_signals.summary: A consortium led by Gaw Capital Partners is seeking to refinance a HK$14.4 billion ($1.8 billion) loan backed by a number of Hong Kong shopping centers, according to people familiar with the matter, as a recovery in the city’s retail sales remains uneven.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Brazil's Lula wins historic presidential election; Bolsonaro reportedly refuses to concede
top_signals.summary: It's the first time since Brazil returned to direct elections in 1989 that a candidate has won the final runoff after losing in the first round.

top_signals.title: New farm minister inspects typhoon damage in Chiba
top_signals.summary: Arata Takebe pledged to do his best to restore damaged facilities to ensure that local farming operations will be conducted normally next year.
